name: hud_ui_message_draw
description: HudUiMessage::Draw paints the message base widget, then draws the embedded text panel.
known_limits: Tier C first; no VC verification target currently covers 0x4134e0, so tier S acceptance remains deferred to a HUD message source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4134e0 validates saving self in esi, calling HudUiWidget::Draw with the original this pointer, loading the embedded panel vtable from self+0xe0, setting ecx to self+0xe0, dispatching vtable slot offset +4, and returning without arguments.
0x4b3fb0 HudUiWidget::Draw is dependency-ready and functionally accepted; the embedded panel draw dispatch uses the recovered HudUiPanel class model used throughout zhud_ui.cpp.

The native message draw smoke invokes HudUiMessage::Draw on an empty typed message, verifies the no-image base path returns without creating draw state, and verifies the embedded panel draw clears dirty empty text state.
